meaning.en: An electric generator that produces alternating current.
meaning.vi: Một máy phát điện tạo ra dòng điện xoay chiều.

meaning.en: An electric generator which produces alternating current through mechanical means.

meaning.en: An electric generator or dynamo producing alternating current.

sentences.en: Polyphase alternators were first exhibited at the Frankfort electrical exhibition in 1891, developed as a consequence of scientific researches by Galileo Ferraris (1847-1897),Nikola Tesla,M.
